entries.이 약에 과민증 환자, 소화성궤양, 심한 혈액 이상, 심한 간장애, 심한: Patients hypersensitive to this medicine, patients with peptic ulcer, severe blood abnormalities, severe liver impairment, severe kidney impairment, or severe cardiac dysfunction, and patients with or with a history of aspirin-induced asthma (asthma attacks induced by non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs) must not take this medicine. entries.이 약에 과민증 환자, 소화성궤양, 심한 혈액이상, 심한 간장애, 심한: Patients hypersensitive to this medicine, patients with peptic ulcer, severe blood abnormalities, severe liver impairment, severe kidney impairment, or severe cardiac dysfunction, patients with or with a history of aspirin-induced asthma (asthma attacks induced by non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs), and patients who have taken barbiturates, tricyclic antidepressants, or alcohol must not take this medicine. entries.이 약에 과민증 환자, 여성, 18세 미만 환자, 심혈관계 질환(관상동맥: Patients hypersensitive to this medicine, women, patients under 18 years of age, patients with cardiovascular disease (coronary artery disease, arrhythmia, congestive heart failure, heart valve disease, treated or untreated high blood pressure, low blood pressure), hair loss without a hereditary cause, sudden patchy hair loss, abnormalities of the scalp (erythema, inflammation, infection, irritation or pain, psoriasis, sunburn), or hair loss of unknown cause, patients who have shaved the scalp, and patients with poor tolerance to the 2% strength must not use this medicine. entries.이 약에 과민증 환자, 이 약 및 이 약의 구성성분, 다른 해열진통제,: Patients hypersensitive to this medicine, people who have experienced asthma when taking this medicine or its ingredients, other antipyretic analgesics, or cold remedies, infants and young children under 3 months of age and under 2 years of age, and women from week 30 of pregnancy onward must not take this medicine. entries.이 약은 감기의 제증상(콧물, 코막힘, 재채기, 인후통, 기침, 가래,: This medicine is used to relieve the various symptoms of a cold (runny nose, nasal congestion, sneezing, sore throat, cough, phlegm, feeling cold and shivering, fever, headache, joint pain, muscle pain).
entries.이 약은 고령자의 건피증, 성인의 거친 피부, 발뒤꿈치 및 복사뼈 부위의: This medicine is used for xeroderma in the elderly, rough skin in adults, and keratosis of the heels and ankle bones.
entries.이 약은 급ㆍ만성 장염, 급ㆍ만성 설사, 급성 이질, 각종 원인에 기인한: This medicine is used for acute and chronic enteritis, acute and chronic diarrhea, acute dysentery, and abnormal intestinal fermentation due to various causes.
entries.이 약은 급만성 호흡기 질환(기관지염, 인후두염, 비인두염등)의 기침,: This medicine is used for cough and phlegm in acute and chronic respiratory diseases (bronchitis, pharyngolaryngitis, nasopharyngitis, etc.) and for cough in children with influenza or a cold.

entries.이 약은 눈의 피로, 눈의 건조에 대한 눈물의 보조, 하드콘택트렌즈 또는: This medicine is used for eye fatigue, as a supplement to tears for dryness of the eye, for discomfort when wearing hard contact lenses or soft lenses, and for blurred vision such as when there is a lot of eye mucus.
entries.이 약은 두통, 치통, 발치후 동통(통증), 인후(목구멍)통, 귀의 통증: This medicine is used to relieve headache, toothache, pain after tooth extraction, sore throat, ear pain, joint pain, neuralgia, back pain, muscle pain, shoulder pain (stiff shoulders), bruise pain, fracture pain, sprain pain, menstrual pain (period pain), and pain from injury, and to reduce fever when there are chills (feeling cold and shivering) or fever.
entries.이 약은 류마티양 관절염, 연소성(어리거나 젊은나이에 나타나는) 류마티양: This medicine is used for rheumatoid arthritis, juvenile (appearing at a young age) rheumatoid arthritis, osteoarthritis (degenerative joint disease), fever and pain due to a cold, back pain, dysmenorrhea, postoperative pain, ankylosing spondylitis, headache, toothache, muscle pain, neuralgia, acute gout, psoriatic arthritis, soft tissue injuries (sprains, contusions (bruises)), and non-articular rheumatic diseases (tendinitis, tenosynovitis, bursitis).
entries.이 약은 먼지, 바람, 건조한 공기, 장기간의 컴퓨터사용에 의한 눈의 건: This medicine is used to moisten the eye in cases of a dry feeling, a foreign body sensation, or a feeling of fatigue in the eye caused by dust, wind, dry air, or prolonged computer use, and discomfort caused by wearing contact lenses.
entries.이 약은 바람, 연기, 공해, 먼지, 건조한 열, 에어컨, 항공 여행,: This medicine is used for dryness of the eye and eye fatigue accompanied by discomfort, stabbing pain, or irritation caused by wind, smoke, pollution, dust, dry heat, air conditioning, air travel, prolonged computer use, and the like.
entries.이 약은 변비와 그에 따른 식욕부진(식욕감퇴), 복부팽만, 장내이상발효,: This medicine is used to relieve constipation and the accompanying loss of appetite, abdominal bloating, abnormal intestinal fermentation, and hemorrhoid symptoms.
